title: 30-Day Money Back Guarantee
bodyHtml:
Your satisfaction is unconditionally guaranteed, no-questions asked! 

Here’s how it works:

Purchase any Naväge Nose Cleaner Bundle from navage.com and use it for up to 30 days. Experience how good nasal hygiene and clear nose-breathing can improve your life!

If you wish to return your Naväge Nasal Care System, contact us at support@navage.com within 30 days of delivery and request a Return Merchandise Authorization (RMA) which we will send you by return email along with shipping instructions. We ask that you pay the shipping fee to send it back to us. 

When we receive the returned product, we will refund your original purchase price, disappointed only that Naväge did not meet your expectations.

In short, use Naväge for up to 30 days at no risk, and find out if it’s right for you!


Please note...

  • The 30-Day, Money Back Guarantee only applies to purchases made on navage.com. It does not apply to purchases at Amazon, eBay, CVS, Walgreens, Walmart, and other retailers. Purchases from other retailers must follow that retailer's return policy.
  • Shipping charges, if any, are non-refundable.
  • Products returned for refund that are not accompanied by an RMA are subject to a 20% restocking fee.
  • Opened Naväge SaltPod 30-Packs are non-refundable.

 

 

Take the Naväge Challenge!

Find out for yourself. Use Naväge twice a day for two weeks and experience what good nasal hygiene and improved nose-breathing can do for you!

title: Shipping Policies
bodyHtml:
Shipping Options

 FREE FAST SHIPPING to the contiguous United States for orders over $29.99, net of discounts, coupons, and other promotions.  For orders under $29.99, standard shipping rates apply.

Additional shipping options available at checkout: 

  • FedEx 2Day
  • FedEx Standard Overnight
  • FedEx SmartPost 

Subscribe & Save customers, please note: If your first Subscribe & Save order also includes non-subscription products and is over $29.99, you qualify for FREE shipping. However, future Subscribe & Save orders that are less than $29.99 will be charged standard shipping rates.

Warehouse Location

We ship from Brooklyn, Ohio.
We regret that customer pick up is not available.

Shipping Options and Cut-Off Times

Flat Rate FedEx SmartPost

FedEx SmartPost is a combination of FedEx and the US Postal Service that starts with FedEx picking up your package from us, and ends with the US Post Office delivering it to your door.

FedEx SmartPost orders require five to eight business days for delivery depending on the destination, not counting the day we receive your order.

SmartPost orders placed received before 10:00 AM Eastern Time, Monday-Friday, will be shipped the same business day they are received. Orders placed after 10:00 AM will be shipped the next business day.

FedEx defines "business day" as Monday-Friday. Business day does not include Saturday, Sunday, and holidays. Saturday and Sunday delivery options are not available at this time. FedEx does not count the day a package is shipped as one of the five to seven days required for delivery.

FedEx SmartPost Delivery Example: If a package is shipped FedEx SmartPost on Friday, it will be delivered between the following Friday and the Wednesday after that.

FedEx Home and FedEx Ground

FedEx Home orders (for shipping to residential addresses) and FedEx Ground orders (for shipping to business addresses) require three to six business days for delivery depending on the destination, not counting the day we receive your order.

FedEx Home and FedEx Ground orders received before 10:00 AM Eastern Time, Monday-Friday, will be shipped the same business day they are received. Orders placed after 10:00 AM will be shipped the next business day. FedEx does not count the day a package is shipped as one of the three to five days required for delivery.

FedEx defines "business day" as Monday-Friday. Business day does not include Saturday, Sunday, and holidays. Saturday and Sunday delivery options are not available at this time.

FedEx Home and FedEx Ground Delivery Example: If a package is shipped FedEx Home or FedEx Ground on Friday, it will be delivered between the next Wednesday and Monday.

FedEx 2Day

FedEx 2Day orders require two business days for delivery, not counting the day the we receive your order.

FedEx 2Day orders that we receive before 12:00 PM Eastern Time, Monday-Friday, will be shipped the same day it is received. An order that is received after 12:00 PM Eastern Time, Monday-Friday, will be shipped the next business day.

FedEx defines "business day" as Monday-Friday. Business day does not include Saturday, Sunday, and holidays. Saturday and Sunday delivery options are not available at this time. FedEx does not count the day a package is shipped as one of the two days required for delivery.

FedEx 2Day Delivery Example: If a package is shipped FedEx 2Day on Friday, it will be delivered on Tuesday.

FedEx Standard Overnight

FedEx Standard Overnight orders require one business day for delivery, not counting the day we receive your order.

FedEx Standard Overnight orders that we receive before 12:00 PM Eastern Time, Monday-Friday, will be shipped the same day it is received. An order that is received after 12:00 PM Eastern Time, Monday-Friday, will be shipped the next business day.

FedEx defines "business day" as Monday-Friday. Business day does not include Saturday, Sunday, and holidays. Saturday and Sunday delivery options are not available at this time.

Example of FedEx Standard Overnight Delivery: If a package is shipped FedEx Standard Overnight on Friday, it will be delivered on Monday.

Order Cancellation Policy

Once an order has been shipped, it cannot be cancelled. (It can be returned for a refund, but it cannot be cancelled.) 

If you need to cancel or make changes to an order, please contact Customer Service as quickly as possible at (800) 203-6400 or support@navage.com . Please review the shipping cut-off times above and note that most orders are shipped the same day that the order is placed, or at the latest, on the next business day. 

Please also note that a delivery that is refused by a customer and returned to RhinoSystems without a Return Merchandise Authorization (RMA) is subject to a 20% restocking fee. 

Incorrect Shipping Address

If an order is undeliverable due to an incorrect address, the shipping company (FedEx, USPS, or UPS) will not redeliver that package for free; they require payment. You are responsible for verifying that your shipping address is correct. Incorrect addresses frequently result in delays, undeliverable packages, and additional fees. 

If you discover that the address you entered is incorrect, please contact us as soon as possible at (800) 203-6400 or support@navage.com, and we will make every effort to correct your order information. If a shipment cannot be delivered because of an incorrect or incomplete address including an incorrect zip code, missing or incorrect suite, office, or street number, etc., then you are responsible for any fees assessed by the shipping company to change the address or return and/or reship your package. 

Please be advised that shipping companies assess a fee to correct and/or redeliver a package that is submitted with incorrect address information.

Damaged or Lost Packages

If you receive a damaged package, or if you believe that your package is lost, please contact us immediately at (800) 203-6400 or support@navage.com.

International Orders and Shipping

For delivery to Canada, please shop at navage.ca.


We do not offer shipping outside the United States and Canada. However, we are aware that some international customers use a third-party shipping company or parcel forwarding agent to arrange their purchase of Naväge. Companies such as USGoBuy.com, MyUS.com, Shipito.com, Stackry.com, and Reship.com provide this service. If you decide to use such a service, you can purchase directly from navage.com and have your Naväge products shipped directly to the third-party agent with a U.S. shipping address.

title: Nasal Irrigation Works
bodyHtml:
If you snore, are frequently all stuffed up, or find it hard to get enough air while exercising, you are not alone! According to WebMD, at least 17 million people suffer from chronic congestion and a staggering 50 million have nasal allergies.  

The good news is that this is a problem with solutions. Some of them are natural and healthy. Others not so much. Antihistamine sprays are effective for a short period, but they also come with a price: over time they become addictive and can destroy vital tissue in the nasal cavity. 

Saline nasal irrigation is a better alternative. It’s an all-natural way to flush, moisturize, and bathe the nasal cavity with saline.

Using products such as Naväge Nasal Care not only avoids steroids and pills, but helps to avoid allergies, post-nasal drip, and congestion. 

Requiring no special-skill set or training, the Naväge Nasal Care system is a completely natural way to prevent snoring, relieve allergies, and drastically improve breathing indefinitely. Not only is it a cost-effective solution to a number of problems, but it completely avoids the necessity for drugs or surgery in many cases. 

Plus, the Naväge Nose Cleaner is a irrigator with gentle powered suction, a game-changer for nasal irrigation. Often referred to as ‘Nature’s Decongestant’, the Naväge nasal hygiene system is promoted by doctors who specialize in the field. 

According to Dr. Howard Levine, “Nasal irrigation is clinically proven to relieve sinus congestion safely and effectively without drugs. Naväge sets the new standard for personal nasal care with its exceptional convenience, consistency, and ease of use.” Dr. Levine is an Ear, Nose, and Throat physician, former head of the Nasal Sinus Department at the Cleveland Clinic and past-president of the American Rhinologic Society.

“Nasal irrigation is a simple, inexpensive treatment that relieves the symptoms of a variety of sinus conditions, reduces use of medical resources, and could help minimize antibiotic resistance.” - Blake Papsin, M.D., Canadian Family Physician Journal
